# AFOS Daily · Daily Synthesis

## 1. Prediction market

The [Polymarket presidential market](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) — with **accumulated aggregate volume of ~USD 87M** since opening, summing the 17 active contracts — registered on Monday, May 25 the **largest compression movement of the Lula × Flávio gap in the cycle**. Lula fell from 45.50% to **39.50%** (accumulated USD 5.85M volume), a decline of **6.00pp in 24h** — the first material movement of the contract after a flatline of more than 100 hours since Wednesday, May 21. Flávio, in turn, rose from 26.05% to **27.65%** (accumulated USD 5.99M volume), recovering 1.60pp after seven consecutive days of decline that began on May 17 (the cycle minimum had been 26.05% on May 24). The gap between the two compressed from +19.45pp to **+11.85pp**, a reduction of 7.60pp in a single session.

In the dispute for the third way, Haddad **surged** to **8.05%** (accumulated USD 5.02M volume), a gain of 3.20pp in 24h and the strongest movement of any secondary candidate in the Polymarket cycle. Renan Santos continued on an upward trajectory with **14.40%** (↑1.35pp 24h, accumulated USD 5.83M volume), consolidating the position of the most quoted third way in the market. Zema declined slightly to 4.65% (accumulated USD 2.85M volume), and Michelle Bolsonaro recovered to **2.00%** (↑0.45pp 24h, accumulated USD 6.70M volume), a partial reversal of Sunday's collapse. Caiado fell 0.10pp to 1.55% (accumulated USD 3.21M volume).

In the second place market (2L), Flávio maintained the top position at 56.50% (USD 58k volume), while Renan Santos surged from 14.25% to **17.85%** (↑3.60pp 24h, USD 1.0M volume), tracking the increase in the 1T contract. Lula fell to 11.00% (↓0.50pp, USD 73k volume), Haddad declined to 4.80% (↓0.75pp, USD 655k volume) — an interesting divergence between Haddad's surge in the 1T and the slight decline in 2L, suggesting that the positive repricing concentrates on the probability of reaching the runoff as top finisher (with Lula ruled out), not as vice. In 3L (third place), the highlight is the **historic Haddad surge from 3.00% to 13.40%** (↑10.40pp in 24h, USD 16k volume), jumping to the fourth position overall behind Renan (35.00%, ↑0.50pp), Zema (26.50%, flat) and Caiado (14.50%, ↓2.00pp).

In the [STF impeachment market before 2027](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027), the contract declined marginally to **6.65%** (↓0.05pp 24h, USD 79k volume), holding above 6% for the fifth consecutive session — upward trajectory consolidated after a low of 4.35% on May 21. In the [Senate plurality market](https://polymarket.com/event/next-brazil-senate-election-most-seats-won), [PL](/en/glossary#pl) declined to **69.50%** (↓0.50pp 24h, USD 243k volume), maintaining dominance. Contracts with low volume showed spikes that should be treated as **distortion, not signal**: [União Brasil](/en/glossary#uniao-brasil) jumped to 12.65% (↑8.35pp 24h) and [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) to 12.90% (↑8.15pp 24h), both with accumulated USD 1k volume — below the relevance threshold (USD 500k) set on May 18. These movements are typically low-liquidity arbitrage.

In [2026 inflation bands](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026), the 5.00–5.49% band **surged** to 37.50% (↑7.10pp 24h vs 30.40%), expanding dominance as the absolute modal band. The 4.50–4.99% band held at 30.20%, while the 5.50–5.99% band contracted to 10.15% (↓6.45pp 24h vs 16.60%). High bands (≥6.50%) rose slightly to 7.10% (↑1.45pp 24h vs 5.65%), a partial reversal of the fiscal tail compression observed over the weekend.

## 2. What the polling institutes recorded

The national agenda of the day was dominated by the **BTG/Nexus** publication with a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) scenario **Lula 47% × Flávio 43%, gap +4pp**, reported consistently by [Estadão](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://news.google.?oc=5), [JOTA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxQVGtmNVY0dzA4ck5FWmRZUW1zSWtxemtHVkhLcFBfemE2bGdZMmdRTlU5QWhLbXB4YlZOWDR5d2dTdlFEM05KTkRTa3I2ZWVIZjF1U2hGR2NRT1Y5SXdYaExsMXlWMjRqV0JPclhJd21ZeXR5OXk5XzlTb3VQdW4zN2l5ZHRyRlhZZEZ6YW1VbWtjS1VwNmNjNG82RDgwdy0xaXZpVUtmWHdpRGJyV1p2eEQwWFJKc3RBZkViMHVWbHN1NVVMMnA0cUpB?oc=5), [GZH](https://news.google.?oc=5) and [Congresso em Foco](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxQS0RnVEJOWDFIX2dvejdSRHFOa2xaSktKbFNWdmVya2E5b2xsRk9xYmtwWXd3Skhqc3pZeFpKRTB4ZHcyeDlnNUFqVW1TZUIyMi13SXpTRzB2S2RjVlNmZnFVSUhOYXZ5NEM3RE1oRnBQVS1XNnAteHJOaUJMRlhiTzVlWXJCY1Z2bDBYUE5QbFllMGtrUkpZ?oc=5). The result is **identical** to the gap registered by [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) on May 22 (47×43, +4pp 2T) — direct confirmation without widening the magnitude. JOTA added complementary analysis on vote transfer in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and [CartaCapital covered](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxPU1Y4SlZSdmdxTGNwUnlEZzMxQzNHSTlFTnhWSWtNVEpVQU8wMmE2UmxweHZaVVZiTENzR1pLVWdJa0lCX0Z0eURIYXZ0M3ZpYWtVMnZFLU5jX1pQQUpmM3lEMk5BS1hPX090SlJaSUp2Ym5mWDRHclpPSE40S05EaFJheV8tM1RVdXJQVks1MS1wX2dwZXc3Z2tfcm1WcXJ3Y2tYTXRiWGpqOG55QzBWaTB4NjJMR2d3?oc=5) how Catholics and evangelicals distribute themselves between Lula and Flávio, according to the same survey.

The aggregate of polls registered at [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) accumulates 296 polls (52 published in the last 15 days). The most active institutes in the recent window are Veritá (10 publications, average sample 1,703), Real Time Big Data (4), [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) (3), [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) (2) and Vox Brasil (2). As reported by [InfoMoney](https://news.google.?oc=5), the next round of Real Time Big Data is already in the field, with Aécio Neves included as a PSDB pre-candidate in the scenario — the first print explicitly testing Aécio's viability as an alternative post-Vorcaro.

## 3. What the press covered

The editorial analysis with the most traction was the column by Amanda Klein in [UOL Economia](https://news.google.?oc=5), with a direct title: "Post-Vorcaro: Lula doesn't win, and Flávio loses little". The reading — according to the columnist — is that Flávio's decline in the Vorcaro audio leaks did not convert into proportional gains for Lula, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) gap remains narrow (4pp in [Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) and [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha)). [CartaCapital](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Lula's advantage plummeted in the Northeast, reaching the smallest difference ever recorded between approval and rejection in the region, fragmenting the "Lula with a wide lead" narrative that had been dominating the post-[Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) story.

In opposition dynamics, Zema returned to criticizing Flávio in an interview reported by [Money Times](https://news.google.?oc=5): "whoever votes for Flávio hands the election to Lula", according to a statement by the governor of Minas Gerais. Caiado, in a parallel response, defended unity among right-wing leaders. Sergio Moro called Lula a "lie of the century" about Lava Jato, as reported by [Congresso em Foco](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxQYlhpNktQM1RTMDR3OUpUNXNsWTRtVW9jbFJjQ2pNOWUxcU1GVm5TVDNUZjlRRkVDVnN0ekx4ZHBLcDNRWHlBRGhSM1VQWEdqU3ZzdjdCb05pS2JsUGpLdFhPeklHMkdadkE0OWRuV1JIbWlLdFRZUHNqcWdlRW5ORThwLW12QmU1aFc3NDd4dVBHT3J6djVqaGVIVzJJMnFJXzJPbGZQS0FIX3FSRVJSTGFVN1VSakpKbHc?oc=5). [Gazeta do Povo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQdm5qY3N4aVBUSURQeVBESUItWlR6Um4yNUpuZWRNc2lMbzZhMW1CdzR3b25EZGI0dTVsVXZCeHRNM2d0Um1uekYyNS03bEM5QkV4dDgwOS1qZEVHMFB0TnRiSUNhRDVwcFVzdVQ0NVZTbUxYanZzQVgzczg0UDkwR05fRVZoMktfTnZ4U1ZiOHVaNmFWZzl6dFRiSGJab1c2cTFxWmlyQXFuVHNGcEM2bjdacEpxcHZNOUhj?oc=5) covered the meeting between Flávio and Donald Trump in the United States — an agenda initiated on May 23 and maintained in development throughout the day. The same Gazeta [published analysis](https://news.google.?oc=5) on the resurgence of Michelle Bolsonaro as a presidential option in electoral surveys.

On the institutional agenda, [Valor Econômico](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that the government closes today its proposal on the transition from the end of the 6×1 work schedule, following a meeting between Lula and the president of the Chamber Hugo Motta — an agenda scheduled since May 23. Gilmar Mendes, in an interview reported by [Tribuna da Internet](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNVHJYNjBxb3UwS0Nod1RLY1NJWXZJeFpPbS1aTGIwMkhMUXh4bzlFNHNuSjBRLWxaUFUzV045dXZZeWVXNmR0eVZCcFYxb201Uzd4WngzTV9wOXhKMmZ1eG9QZXdfT1Z3TjZkdnlSVjJGYnl2eGk0ZTZLOWhKQmdzYVNiNG9yUVc4RU1sSHlRbnVjNmdOZlktUW5oOG50TXNGbXBuamYxRXBkYll3Y0VKVENvcnMtQ3hUUFRPLVgzQTlCbUM1aHc?oc=5), stated that the post-Vorcaro crisis "is not in the [STF](/en/glossary#stf), but on Faria Lima" — an institutional signal from the minister about the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case. [BBC News Brasil](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5Wd2hlaDJvTlMxVzU2Z3MzMVZXRk5Ia2NSRlhZNVpSNWRVLUZOdVJvUFR0RG9nb1dtZmZiVEJFUGdMT2trLThxWG9VYzZ0S1JvYUJ5WWVnMVpJajRidWJwa2F30gFnQVVfeXFMUENOOTRxVDNvRkV1RENLcnpmNWZQa2dXOG43YXp0SjU5TFBjMkJ3ODMwZDNUc2otRXhlU3dERU9tTHZBV3ExV0JmMWQtQkNZM2YwY09RaWpEb0YtLVc4N05RT3UtTHVFTQ?oc=5) published analysis on how AI is "supercharging the arsenal" of 2026 election campaigns, an editorial report on the use of artificial intelligence tools by candidate teams.

## 4. Day's divergences

> **Market × survey (historical compression of magnitude):** [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) was pricing the Lula × Flávio gap at **+19.45pp [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)** on May 24. The publication of BTG/[Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) on May 25 with [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) gap **+4pp** (identical to [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) from May 22) compressed the market gap by **7.60pp in 24h** — to +11.85pp. This is the **first material compression of the divergence magnitude in the cycle**. The market is approaching surveys for the first time since the peak of divergence (+13pp Poly × +3pp [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) on May 16).

> **Haddad surge — [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) × narrative:** The Haddad presidential contract jumped from 4.85% to **8.05%** (↑3.20pp in 24h) and the 3L jumped from 3.00% to **13.40%** (↑10.40pp), the largest movement of any secondary candidate in the cycle. The day's press coverage practically did not cover Haddad directly — the repricing appears to be the market's internal reading on a scenario in which Lula retreats or weakens, with Haddad stepping in as [PT](/en/glossary#pt) successor/replacement. No confirmed editorial source explicitly addresses this hypothesis today.

> **Low-liquidity anomalies in Senate:** [União Brasil](/en/glossary#uniao-brasil) and [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) contracts in the Senate plurality market jumped to 12.65% and 12.90% respectively (↑8pp in 24h each), with cumulative volume of only USD 1k in both. These movements are **low-liquidity arbitrage, not signals of real repricing**. Should be ignored until confirmation of recurring flow above USD 500k cumulative. [PL](/en/glossary#pl) Senate maintains structural dominance at 69.50% (vol USD 243k — comparison baseline).

## Summary

1. **Largest compression of the Polymarket cycle gap:** Lula × Flávio closed from +19.45pp to +11.85pp in 24 hours, with Lula declining 6.00pp for the first time in more than 100 hours after the [Nexus/BTG Pactual](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) publication confirmed (without expanding) the 4pp [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) gap registered by [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) on May 22.
2. **Haddad as the day's highlight:** spike of 3.20pp in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) to 8.05% and of 10.40pp in the third place to 13.40% — movements of unprecedented magnitude in the cycle, possibly reflecting repricing as [PT](/en/glossary#pt) substitute/successor in scenarios where Lula declines.
3. **Magnitude divergence remains open but in accelerated compression:** [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) +11.85pp vs polls [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) +4pp. For the first time in the cycle, the market moves actively toward the poll number. Next polls (including Real Time Big Data with Aécio Neves) and [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) print in June will determine whether the validation cycle closes or reopens.
